name: Andred

attributes.attribute: cousin of Tristan and a spy for King Mark
said to have killed Tristan for the king’s favor

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Andred is an Arthurian hero. He was a cousin of the celebrated hero, Tristan. Andred served King Mark as a spy. Mark was the husband of Iseult, the woman Tristan loved. Some texts say that Andred killed Tristan to win the king’s favor.

key_results: Show his spy work for King Mark.
Show the charge that he killed Tristan.
